stats.title: Statistics

models.title: Models
models.notEnoughHint: Needs at least {{min}} timed dictations, this model has {{count}}.

translit.title: Written in Cyrillic
translit.hint: Known technical terms the model spelled with Cyrillic letters.

footer.clearConfirm: Delete all recorded statistics? History and audio stay.

initialPrompt.title: Context phrase
initialPrompt.description: A natural sentence with your terms. Whisper reads it as context and spells those words right. Leave it empty to turn it off.
initialPrompt.placeholder: A sentence that uses your terms

fixCase.title: Fix case of dictionary words
fixCase.description: After recognition, “langchain” becomes “LangChain” when the word is in your dictionary.

handyImport.title: Import custom words from Handy
handyImport.body: Your Handy settings have words Voxa does not know yet: {{words}}. Voxa only reads that file and never changes it.

fillers.title: Filler words
fillers.description: Words the Words tab counts as fillers, separated by commas. A phrase of up to three words (like “you know”) counts as one filler.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Voxa looks for a new version on start and every 6 hours. It never installs anything without your click; models, history, statistics and settings stay as they are.
updates.installing: Installing. Voxa will restart in a moment.

auto.title: Check for updates automatically
auto.description: Looks for a new version when Voxa starts and every 6 hours, quietly in the background. You can still check by hand.
auto.locked: Updates are turned off by the system configuration.

error.disabled: Updates are turned off by the system configuration.
error.notConfigured: Updates are not set up yet: the release signing key is missing. See docs/SETUP_SECRETS.md.
error.network: Could not reach GitHub. Check the connection and try again. The current version keeps working.
error.signature: The update did not pass the signature check and was not installed. The current version keeps working.
error.other: The update did not work out. The current version keeps working.

empty.title: No words yet
empty.body: Dictate something and the word statistics will appear here.

backfill.hint: The numbers below fill in as it goes.

top.title: Top words
top.hint: The most used words in the period. Click a word for details.

openers.title: How dictations begin
openers.hint: The first one or two words, as a share of all dictations.

phrases.title: Frequent phrases
phrases.hint: Two- and three-word phrases used at least twice. Phrases made only of function words are left out.

fillers.title: Filler words
fillers.hint: Counts of the words you chose. Edit the list in Settings, Advanced.
fillers.trendEmpty: Not enough data for a trend yet.
